display.purpose: The portal hero title and the closing CTA. One per page at most. Italic within it is set in Hinge Brass — the only place the accent carries a word.

title.purpose: Section heads, card names, drawer and checkout heads. Always serif — a product's name is set the way a name is set.

body.purpose: Base prose. Long-form that is the point of a section rises into serif at clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 30px)/1.5.

label.purpose: Every button, nav link, field label and meta line. Uppercase; tracking widens as the size drops.

kicker.purpose: The eyebrow above a headline, in Brass Deep. The widest tracking in the system (0.34em–0.38em).

shadows.name: object-cast
shadows.purpose: A door leaf or any depicted physical slab. Offset on x as well as y — the light has a direction.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Card hover, pointer devices only, paired with translateY(-5px). Deepens to rgba(0,0,0,0.45) on dark worlds.

shadows.name: aperture-inset
shadows.purpose: The framed opening in the hero and the world cards.

shadows.name: aperture-deep
shadows.purpose: The dark room behind an open door leaf.

shadows.name: floating-chrome
shadows.purpose: Toast and other fixed chrome. The cart drawer uses -30px 0 70px rgba(24, 17, 9, 0.25) for its left-cast edge.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Field focus, paired with a brass border. Global focus is outline: 2px solid var(--brass) at 2px offset.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Colour and border transitions on buttons, links, chips and fields.

motion.name: ease-lift
motion.purpose: Card hover lift and its shadow.

motion.name: ease-swing
motion.purpose: The door leaf opening. Decelerating hard at the end so the leaf settles like weight, not like a tween.

motion.name: ease-overshoot
motion.purpose: Door Wall tiles and other pop-forward transforms.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Entrance for stacked page content; staggered at 0.08s / 0.16s / 0.26s.

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: The default action plate: square, hairline Ink border, wide-tracked micro-caps. Inverts to Ink-on-Cream on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-block; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #211a12); background: none; color: var(--ink, #211a12); padding: 13px 24px; font: 500 12px var(--sans, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.25s, color 0.25s, border-color 0.25s; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--ink, #211a12); color: var(--cream, #f5f0e6); } } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass, #a98b4f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committed action. Ink fill that warms to Hinge Brass on hover — the system's one sanctioned moment of brass as a field.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #211a12); background: var(--ink, #211a12); color: var(--cream, #f5f0e6); padding: 13px 24px; font: 500 12px var(--sans, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.25s, color 0.25s, border-color 0.25s; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brass, #a98b4f); border-color: var(--brass, #a98b4f); color: var(--cream, #f5f0e6); } } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass, #a98b4f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quick-pick Chip
components.description: The one pill in a square system. Deliberately the softest control on the page so the size shortcuts read as suggestions beneath the sliders that own the real decision.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: none; border: 1px solid var(--line2, #d9cdb2); border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 12px; font: 400 12.5px var(--sans, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--mut, #6f6354); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--brass, #a98b4f); color: var(--ink, #211a12); } } .ds-chip--on { border-color: var(--ink, #211a12); background: var(--ink, #211a12); color: var(--cream, #f5f0e6); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass, #a98b4f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Square, hairline-bordered, flat at rest. The product stands on a Panel-gradient stage at 44% of the stage width; the category is a brass micro-cap, the name is serif.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--cream2, #fbf7ef); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e6dcc6); display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; max-width: 300px; transition: transform 0.45s ease, box-shadow 0.45s ease; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 26px 50px rgba(35, 25, 12, 0.12); } } .ds-card__stage { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--panel, #efe7d6), #e8dec7); padding: 44px 0 38px; display: flex; justify-content: center; } .ds-card__leaf { width: 44%; min-width: 100px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 8; background: linear-gradient(100deg, #8a6a3c, #b08c4e 40%, #7d5f34); box-shadow: 6px 8px 26px rgba(28, 20, 10, 0.3); } .ds-card__body { padding: 22px 26px 26px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-card__cat { font: 500 11px var(--sans, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.24em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--brass, #a98b4f); } .ds-card__name { margin: 0; font: 500 25px/1.1 var(--serif, 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif); color: var(--ink, #211a12); } .ds-card__tag { margin: 0; font: 400 13.5px var(--sans, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--mut, #6f6354); } .ds-card__row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-top: 14px; } .ds-card__price { font: 600 16px var(--sans, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #211a12); } .ds-card__from { font: 400 12px var(--sans, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--mut2, #8a7a62); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square, 48px minimum, 16px type — below 16px iOS Safari zooms the page on focus and never zooms back. Focus is a brass border with a soft brass halo, never the UA outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; max-width: 320px; } .ds-field__label { font: 500 11px var(--sans, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mut2, #8a7a62); } .ds-field__input { font: 400 16px var(--sans, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #211a12); background: var(--cream2, #fbf7ef); border: 1px solid var(--line2, #d9cdb2); border-radius: 0; -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; width: 100%; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-field__input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--brass, #a98b4f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(169, 139, 79, 0.18); } .ds-field__hint { font: 400 12.5px var(--sans, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--mut2, #8a7a62); }

components.name: Door Scene
components.description: The signature component. A leaf hinged on its left edge swings open in 3D over a warm aperture, with an edge shade that fades in as it opens. Everything else in the system is downstream of this gesture.
components.css: .ds-door { position: relative; width: 132px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 8; perspective: 1400px; } .ds-door__aperture { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a2a19, #17100a); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(22, 14, 5, 0.55), inset 0 0 24px rgba(22, 14, 5, 0.38); } .ds-door__leaf { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform-origin: left center; transform: rotateY(0deg); transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.15, 1), box-shadow 0.7s ease; background: linear-gradient(100deg, #8a6a3c, #b08c4e 42%, #7d5f34); box-shadow: 6px 8px 26px rgba(28, 20, 10, 0.3); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 12px; } .ds-door__leaf::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(20, 13, 6, 0.55), transparent 45%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.7s ease; } .ds-door__panel { flex: 1; border: 1px solid rgba(38, 26, 12, 0.5); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 236, 190, 0.14); } .ds-door__knob { position: absolute; right: 10px; top: 52%; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--brass, #a98b4f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(30, 20, 8, 0.5); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-door:hover .ds-door__leaf { transform: rotateY(-26deg); } .ds-door:hover .ds-door__leaf::after { opacity: 1; } }

components.name: Kicker + Headline
components.description: The system's standard section opener: a brass micro-cap eyebrow with a rotated diamond, then a Cormorant headline. The clearest single view of the serif/sans division of labour.
components.html:
Made in our own factory

Every leaf cut to your frame
components.css: .ds-head { max-width: 640px; } .ds-kicker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font: 600 12px var(--sans, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.34em; color: var(--brass-d, #8c6f3f); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-diamond { width: 9px; height: 9px; background: var(--brass, #a98b4f); transform: rotate(45deg); display: inline-block; flex: none; } .ds-headline { margin: 14px 0 0; font: 500 clamp(40px, 5vw, 68px)/1.04 var(--serif, 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif); color: var(--ink, #211a12); } .ds-headline em { font-style: italic; color: var(--brass, #a98b4f); }

narrative.overview:
Every surface behaves like a door. The site is not a page you scroll but a sequence of openings you pass through — the hero door swings and you are pushed through it into a corridor of four more; a product card's leaf falls ajar as you approach; a world page is an arched opening with the material full-bleed behind it. The reward for moving is always something opening. Nothing here is a container with content inside it; everything is a frame with something beyond it.

The ground is warm paper — a cream family from #f5f0e6 up to #fbf7ef — ruled with hairlines and set in a Cormorant Garamond that reads like a printed catalogue rather than a web headline. Against that paper, the only colour that belongs to the interface is brass: never a fill, always an edge. Everything with actual chroma in it is the material itself — teak, golden-teak, birch ply, slate-green WPC, and the client's own door photography. The system is deliberately drained so the wood is the loudest thing on screen.

Corners are square as a rule (border-radius: 0, asserted even over iOS's default input rounding). Controls are hardware, not software: thin metal rules, wide-tracked uppercase micro-caps, plates that look screwed to a door rather than tapped on a phone. The confirmed rejection is anything toy-like — the glass-globe world cards were removed in August 2026 because a spinning specular sweep and a bobbing float read as a toy against the rest of the site — and anything that looks like default browser feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground; all chroma comes from real material, not from the UI
Square corners, hairline borders, no radius unless a shape demands it
Brass as an edge and a rule; gold reserved for dark grounds only
Serif names the thing, sans explains it
Depth is light falling on an object, not elevation stacking
Phone-first: 44px targets, 16px fields, safe-area padding, hover behind a query

rules.name: The Two Golds Rule
rules.body: Brass belongs to cream grounds; gold belongs to dark grounds. They never swap. Brass on a dark band goes muddy and gold on cream goes weak — the split is what keeps both of them looking like metal and light rather than two yellows.

rules.name: The Brass Edge Rule
rules.body: On cream, brass is an edge, a rule, a ring or a diamond — never a field. If a large area needs to be dark, it is Ink; if it needs to be warm, it is Panel. A brass block is always wrong.

rules.name: The Material Owns the Colour Rule
rules.body: Saturation comes from teak, veneer, ply and WPC — the actual product. The interface stays neutral so the material reads as the only real thing on the page. A decorative colour with no material behind it does not belong in this system.

rules.name: The Serif Names, The Sans Explains Rule
rules.body: Cormorant carries names, titles and prose that wants to be read slowly. Archivo carries everything functional — controls, labels, prices, specs, meta. A serif inside a button is wrong; so is a sans product name outside the Ply world, which deliberately runs its titles in uppercase sans because a spec sheet should not be lyrical.

rules.name: The Micro-Caps Rule
rules.body: Functional text is uppercase Archivo at 11–13px with at least 0.18em tracking, and it never grows. Emphasis in this system comes from scale in the serif, never from a bigger label.

rules.name: The 44px Rule
rules.body: Every interactive target is at least 44px in its smallest dimension inside the phone breakpoints, and every form control is at least 16px of type — below that iOS Safari zooms the page on focus and never zooms back.

rules.name: The Centred-Without-Translate Rule
rules.body: Absolutely positioned centred elements use left: 0; right: 0 with width: fit-content; margin: 0 auto, never left: 50% plus translateX(-50%). The latter shrink-to-fits inside half the available width and wraps the text.

rules.name: The Offset Cast Rule
rules.body: Any shadow depicting a real object is offset on both axes. A centred, evenly-diffused shadow says "CSS box"; an offset one says "there is a lamp in this room". Interface shadows may be centred; object shadows may not.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: Buttons, inputs, chips, nav and cards carry no shadow at rest. If a surface needs separating, it gets a hairline rule or a tonal step in the cream family, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: A new control starts at radius 0. Rounding is a decision that must name which of the four sanctioned curves it is using and why; "it looked softer" is not a reason.

dos: Do start every control at border-radius: 0 and justify any curve against one of the four sanctioned shapes.
Do keep brass on cream and gold on dark (The Two Golds Rule).
Do use brass as an edge — rule, ring, underline, diamond — not as a field.
Do set names and headlines in Cormorant and everything functional in uppercase Archivo at 0.18em or wider.
Do wrap every colour-changing :hover in @media (hover: hover). Touch latches :hover on the last thing tapped, so an "Add to cart" you just pressed would sit lit until you tapped elsewhere.
Do give a touch equivalent to anything that only reveals itself on hover — the door swing's --ajar class is the pattern to copy.
Do keep form controls at 16px or larger and interactive targets at 44px or larger inside the phone breakpoints.
Do pad fixed chrome with env(safe-area-inset-*).
Do offset object shadows on both axes and leave interface chrome flat.
Do let the material carry the saturation; keep the interface neutral.
donts: Don't add toy-like or glossy 3D — spheres, specular sweeps, bobbing floats, glass. The glass-globe world cards were removed for exactly this, and the replacement is flat material under an arch.

Don't ship default browser feedback. The grey tap-highlight is killed globally because it reads as cheap; every component owns its pressed and hover state, and focus is the brass ring, never the UA outline.
Don't let iOS restyle a control — inputs are explicitly de-rounded and de-appearanced, and a new control must do the same.
Don't put a serif inside a button, or grow a label to create emphasis.
Don't introduce a colour that no material on the floor actually has.
Don't use left: 50% + translateX(-50%) to centre absolutely positioned content (The Centred-Without-Translate Rule).
Don't reuse the arch on anything that is not an opening.
